decision.observation: Monday the 8th, 7:40 p.m.; the farmer has reached the paved approach west of Pelican Town, with the cobblestone route clear to the east.
decision.hypothesis: Continuing east will reach the town junction, from which the established southeast branch leads toward the fountain and southern road.
decision.memory: Objective: meet Willy at the beach south of Pelican Town to receive his item. The journal's 5:00 p.m. time has passed, but his later availability is untested. From the southern town junction, stay on the eastbound cobblestone road; avoid the wooded southern exit and grass below the road.
